# PR155 R6 HARDWARE DIAGNOSTIC BUILD (stacked on PR141, draft/unmerged).
# R4 verified on real CYD: red SD removal icon, no lag, 3.2 full-width explorer.
# R5 failures reported again: hot reinsertion stays offline; format fails.
# R6: manual RESCAN wakes SD worker immediately via FreeRTOS notification;
# warm up dedicated CYD SD SPI with 96 idle clocks before repeat mount;
# expose mount status/attempt count on offline SD FILES screen, 1.2s refresh.
# On format failure, report the specific marker/drive/FatFs/remount stage.
# R6 does not change destructive FAT target matching rules; use spare card.
# 2.8 ST7789 and 3.2 ST7798, standard first; optional 80MHz.
# No production version/tag, no merge, no branch deletion.
